He faces diagonally away toward screen-UP-RIGHT; see mostly back and right profile. Keep a SQUARE1254x1254 transparent RGBA canvas with the original wide unused margins. The top of hair is now aroundy500, knees aroundx700,y1090 and feet trail towardx520,y1210. Keep the rear-right view so the knees/feet foreshorten diagonally rather than a long side profile.
